original_test_intent: Verify the effective Processor Family enumeration for every expected SMBIOS Type 4 processor/socket record matches the approved CPU family baseline and persists after reboot, including correct use of the extended family field when the legacy field selects it.
original_method: Capture all Type 4 records in decoded and raw form, retain socket designation/population status, resolve the effective family from the base and Processor Family 2 encoding as required by the applicable SMBIOS version, compare per socket with the approved platform CPU recipe, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected effective family map, SMBIOS-version semantics and reboot plan. Collection and family-resolution comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved effective Processor Family per expected socket
Applicable SMBIOS version and base/extended-family enum mapping
CPU platform recipe for cross-check without substituting model string
Validated raw/decoded tooling and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS/CPU identity only; do not hotplug CPUs or alter firmware.
Preserve all Type 4 records, base and extended raw family values plus errors; grep text alone cannot prove correct enum selection.
Do not infer family solely from Version/model string or OS marketing name.
Apply the approved unpopulated-socket and Unknown/Other/reserved policy and reject missing/duplicate socket records.
Stop on inconsistent base/extended encoding, mapping drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete raw/decoded Type 4 evidence, resolve effective family per socket from the correct enum fields, compare with the approved CPU recipe and repeat after reboot.
Do not modify processor state, guess family from marketing text or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected family enum map, extended-field interpretation and unsupported-value policy.
Resolve firmware enum versus installed CPU discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is relevant, but grep loses record boundaries and raw base/extended encodings, suppresses errors and cannot validate every socket.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete decoded and raw Type 4 output with tool/errors, bind records by socket/status and calculate the effective Processor Family using the applicable base/Family 2 rule.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Processor Family scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each expected Type 4 record, retain the legacy family byte and extended Processor Family 2 value, apply the specification's selector rule, compare the effective enum with the approved per-socket CPU family and preserve the mapping across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 4 systems, particularly processors represented by extended family encodings.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, parser/dmidecode, BIOS, CPU and platform recipe revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 Processor Family and Processor Family 2 enumeration rules and installed tooling documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw base/extended encoding and per-socket effective-family resolution instead of accepting decoded grep strings.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; adds selector-consistency and invalid/reserved-enum detection.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected family enum and applicable SMBIOS mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A correct broad family enum does not validate exact model, stepping, microcode or functional CPU health.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve supported Unknown/Other or an extended enum for specific socket classes, but must retain both raw fields and the exact SMBIOS-version rule; it cannot substitute model-string equality for family encoding.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected per-socket family map, selector rule and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 4 table with socket/status/base/extended/effective family

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and criteria consistently target Processor Family metadata; base-versus-extended encoding is a version-aware implementation detail, not contradictory intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The effective field can be resolved safely; expected family and enum mapping are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Replaces decoded line fragments with complete per-socket base/extended enum evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps complete-set mapping and recovery while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds Family 2 selector semantics, raw enum preservation and clear separation from model/microcode coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible decoded family string from masking incorrect legacy/extended encoding, wrong socket mapping or incomplete Type 4 inventory.
independent_technical_reasoning: After SMBIOS/version and expected family inputs are approved, the core extraction, effective-enum resolution and reboot comparison are fully software-controlled.
